importRules.identifiers: Resolve ref fields to generated UUID values during import.
importRules.currentUser: Replace source=currentUser with the authenticated user; never create or overwrite that user's password.
importRules.syntheticUsers: Generate an unguessable password, store only its Argon2 hash, and discard the password.
importRules.money: Amounts are decimal strings. Recalculate wallet currentBalance with Decimal.js and verify against the supplied value.
importRules.transactionality: Install every section inside one Prisma transaction and roll back the entire sample workspace on failure.
importRules.idempotency: Use key + formatVersion + current user to reopen an existing sample workspace instead of duplicating it.
